# teams_meeting_policy_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a MeetingPolicy instance to a user via Grant-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Assign a custom meeting policy to a user. The grant is asynchronous; Terraform
# waits until the assignment is effective.
resource "teams_meeting_policy" "restricted" {
  identity       = "RestrictedExternal"
  allow_meet_now = false
}

resource "teams_meeting_policy_assignment" "exec" {
  user        = "user@contoso.com" # object ID or UPN
  policy_name = teams_meeting_policy.restricted.identity
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_name` (String) Name of the TeamsMeetingPolicy instance to assign to the user.
- `user` (String) User the policy is assigned to (object id or user principal name). Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Assignment identifier (the user's object id or user principal name).
